mission: Apply the sign-poisoning fix to tapit-attest verifyEnvelope — switch to quorum-of-good semantics so a relayer-appended junk signature cannot invalidate a genuine envelope. Add a regression test.

reason: Switch verifyEnvelope to quorum-of-good semantics — at least one valid signature suffices; invalid signatures reported in errors but no longer poison the result. Duplicate bad rows for an otherwise-valid signer are dropped from errors.
Added two regression tests: (1) a relayer-appended junk signature does not poison a genuine envelope; (2) a duplicate bad row for a valid signer is not counted as an error.

Vite config with manualChunks splitting react/supabase/attest into separate bundles so the login surface ships without IndexedDB or tapit-attest weight.

Re-encrypt + persist current wallet state. Only callsite that needs the in-memory passphrase downstream of unlock.
